evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -65.7 to -54.1 in t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than its last 28-day mean despite TRANSIT remaining above -55.

candidate_trigger: TRANSIT crosses above -55 percent change from baseline
